modonomicon.configuration.enableSmoothZo: Animates zooming in and out on book category screens.
modonomicon.configuration.fontFallbackLo: Adds languages that should use the Minecraft font when reading the book.
modonomicon.configuration.storeLastOpenP: Remembers the page when leaving an entry. Closing the book with Esc always remembers the page.
theurgy.configuration.additionalTooltipH: Adds sulfur tooltips for sulfur items from the listed namespaces. Theurgy and KubeJS are included by default.
theurgy.configuration.enableItemHUD.tool: Shows status information for held items such as the mercurial wand.
theurgy.configuration.hudScale.tooltip: Changes the size of the status text for held items.
theurgy.configuration.renderSulfurSource: Overlays the source item icon on its sulfur jar. The item name still shows the source when the icon is hidden.
theurgy.configuration.sulfurSourceToBloc: Maps the sulfur source to the block a crafted rod should find. Use source=block or #sourcetag=#blocktag.
theurgy.configuration.useSimpleWireRende: Uses simple lines for wires. This can make them visible with some shaders.
